title: Custom Drink Coaster - 4Pack
descriptionHtml:
Your logo. Your colours. Your table.

Turn your team logo, business branding or custom artwork into a set of four drink coasters. Made to order by Sign Guy in Ontario for your home bar, desk, game-night table or next event.

Design your custom coasters in Sign Studio

Upload your logo, position it on your round coaster, add text and choose your colours. Preview your design in Sign Studio before placing your order.

Make it yours

  • Your artwork: Upload and position your logo or image in Sign Studio.
  • Your colours and text: Choose a background, adjust your artwork colours and add text. Use up to eight colours across your design.
  • Your set: Four matching custom drink coasters in every pack.

Clear logos with bold shapes and readable text work best. Upload the cleanest file you have; very fine lines and small details may need simplifying for a clean print.

Your custom drink coasters

  • 4-pack: Four coasters featuring your custom design for $30.00 CAD.
  • Surface protection: A place for your drink that helps protect the surface underneath.
  • Made to order: Custom printed by Sign Guy in Ontario.

One pack contains four matching coasters. To order more of the same design, adjust the number of packs in your cart; two packs contain eight coasters.

How to order

  1. Open the custom coaster designer in Sign Studio.
  2. Upload your logo or artwork, choose its placement, add text and select your colours.
  3. Review your design, select Place Order in Sign Studio, then complete checkout. Each pack contains four identical coasters.

For different artwork or colours, add each design to your cart separately.

Made for your setup

  • Team gifts and game-night gatherings
  • Home bars, coffee tables and desks
  • Business branding, events and custom gifts

A few helpful answers

How many coasters are included?
Each $30.00 CAD pack includes four matching custom coasters.

Can I use more than one colour?
Yes. Your design can use up to eight colours in total, including the background, logo and text. All four coasters in a pack share the same design.

What size are the coasters?
Each round coaster is 101.66 mm across and 4 mm thick, with artwork and text flush with the top surface.

Need care details?
Ask Sign Guy before ordering if you need a specific fit or cleaning guidance.

Complete your setup

Pair your coasters with a Custom Classic Hype Chain, Custom Logo LED Sign or Custom 3D Plaque using the same team logo or branding.
